project_type: Node.js worksheet build pipeline (Playwright PDF generator)
build_system: Node.js with Playwright for headless PDF rendering
verification_instructions: 1. Run `node build.mjs topics/expanding-double-brackets.json` from the worksheet-factory directory. 2. Confirm dist/ contains the landscape and booklet PDFs. 3. Run `node build.mjs topics/expanding-double-brackets.json dist vi` (or equivalent VI build command) to generate VI-adapted versions. 4. Confirm all 4 PDFs exist in dist/.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory contains generated HTML and PDF files. Not checked in - regenerated on demand.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/send-assistant/worksheet-factory && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
environment_constraints: Playwright requires chromium. node_modules already present. The factory does NOT currently have a VI-adapted build mode - this needs to be added.
contribution_requirements: Topic JSON follows the exact structure of introduction-to-algebra.json. Visual aid uses the 'grid' type from the visual registry in render.mjs. VI-adapted version needs larger fonts (min 18pt), high contrast, generous spacing, and text descriptions for all visual content per RNIB Clear Print guidelines.
key_patterns: Topic JSON has meta/landscape/booklet sections. landscape.intro contains header, subheader, note, visual (type+params), methodSteps, commonMistakes, workedExample. landscape.questions is an array of 8 questions with number/marks/difficulty/content. booklet has intro, methodReminder, questions (with optional frame scaffolds), selfReflection, answers. Visual types: tiles, intersection, grid, none. Build produces two PDFs: <Title>-Landscape-Base.pdf and <Title>-Base.pdf.
directory_structure: worksheet-factory/ - build pipeline root. topics/ - topic JSON files. dist/ - generated output. render.mjs - HTML templating with visual registry. build.mjs - orchestrates Playwright PDF generation.
